**Finding submitted — ASSIGN: deviation (§ 14.10 Assignment, p0188).**

- **Issue:** The clause binds only us. IBM may assign freely (no consent requirement, no competitor bar), so the fallback mutuality elements fail; our M&A carve-out also omits Affiliates and sale of substantially all assets. No change-of-control provision exists anywhere in the document (searched "change of control", termination sections), so no term is flagged twice.
- **Cure (preferred level, two surgical ops):** (1) expand our consent-free carve-out to an Affiliate or successor by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, preserving the surrounding words verbatim; (2) insert a short reciprocal restriction — IBM may not assign without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a Customer competitor, and our change of control gives IBM no termination right.
- Void-assignment and continuing-liability mechanics, and the existing consent standard for our other assignments, are left intact; redline validated ok:true.
